ap.recovery.note: Per-corps C9 formula; no PK180 hard cap; floor core before talisman bonus. AP ability getter and extreme cross-corps port-parent edge remain open.

engine.apScope.note: One first corps of one force; unmodified synthetic abilities; at least one owned city. Active physically-at-base officer headcount is an explicit bounded adapter; mission-in-base counts, absent/unit/prisoner does not. Role parameters are independent of location. Split corps and complete source selector remain unsupported.

engine.calendar.note: Integer xun calendar 1→11→21→next month, with seasons beginning1/4/7/10. Month/season markers do not execute omitted economy.

engine.progression.note: Cumulative XP clamps at 3000; every 100 contributes one growth point; unmodified synthetic talent plus floor(XP/100) clamps to 1..100. Source-profile bytes do not certify stock PK equivalence. No age, research command, injury, equipment or special roster ID700..799 path.

engine.scheduler.note: Explicit replaceable phase order; only calendar, current first-corps AP, controlled-base training flags and represented officer action flags. No inferred original global scheduler, missions, AI or economy.

engine.rng.originalEvidence: new engineering mechanism; no original RNG algorithm claim
engine.rng.note: Serializable xorshift32 is injectable and reserved for future core rules; training/AP/calendar do not draw. It is not the game PRNG or its sequence.

engine.presentationOmitted.note: Original 005C4442 calls00472150(3) for a speaking officer and can retry an empty slot. This kernel deliberately omits that presentation path; zero core draws does NOT preserve the full game shared RNG stream.

engine.scope.note: Validated lifecycle-v2 serializable synthetic state, atomic commands, cumulative WAR experience, trace and save format. Unsupported lifecycle transitions are not simulated.

engine.version.note: The engine targets PC-PK1.1/original fix profile but source-profile lifecycle reconstruction is not clean-stock certification. Vanilla/PS2/Wii remain separately unsupported.

engine.eligibility.note: Independent identity/location/mission dimensions. Training requires active identity0..3, at the selected base, no mission and not acted. AP headcounts include active officers physically at a base; mission-in-base remains counted. These bounded status mappings are not complete original validator semantics.
